artworks.title: Jacob Wrestling with the Angel
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing depicting a biblical scene. Various animals are being herded across the landscape by figures. In the foreground, a group of figures sits and kneels, one holding a child. A shepherd guides the animals. Towards the right, two figures are depicted in an embrace or struggle, with soldiers or warriors marching above them. The drawing features intricate line work and shading, reminiscent of woodcut or etching techniques. A passage from Genesis is written at the bottom of the image. The overall tone is historical and narrative-driven.

artworks.title: Joseph Recounts His Dreams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered together with celestial symbols in the sky. The drawing depicts a group of men standing close to one another engaged in what appears to be a serious conversation or interaction. At the top right of the image, there are celestial symbols including a sun, a crescent moon, and an array of stars depicted in the sky, partially obscured by billowing clouds. In the background, there are hills or dunes, and in the foreground, there is text written in German. The style is reminiscent of woodcut prints or engravings commonly seen in early printmaking.

artworks.title: Joseph Thrown into the Well
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several men surrounding a hole with one figure trapped inside. The men are shown pulling on ropes or gesturing animatedly. The scene takes place outdoors with trees, buildings, and animals in the background. Old-fashioned text at the bottom adds to the narrative context. The figures are depicted with muscular detail and dynamic poses.

artworks.title: Joseph Sold to the Ishmaelites
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people and camels engaged in various actions in an outdoor setting. The composition depicts several individuals clustered around a table-like structure. The scene is set in an arid environment, suggested by the presence of camels laden with goods. In the background, other figures are engaged in activities around a large basin or container. The drawing captures a moment of bustling activity, with detailed rendering of clothing, facial expressions, and animals. Various items like barrels and packs are drawn with attention to detail, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Finding of Moses
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of women by a riverbank. The central figure, wearing a crown, is reaching towards a person in the river who is holding a baby wrapped in cloth. The background includes trees, hills, and lush landscape details. The drawing is detailed and elegant. The bottom of the drawing features German text in decorative script.

artworks.title: Moses and the Burning Bush
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure emerging from clouds in front of a kneeling figure on a hillside. The image shows a bearded figure amidst swirling clouds reaching out towards a kneeling figure on a hillside. The foreground features a flock of sheep grazing, while the background shows rolling hills and a village in a valley. The scene is rendered in a monochrome line style and includes an inscription at the bottom.

artworks.title: Moses and the Serpent
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man near a flaming bush. The man stands on the right side with one hand stretched towards the burning bush. Another figure emerges from the bush. The bush is depicted with flames and smoke, stylized with intricate lines. The background shows a landscape with trees and hills. The lines in the drawing are detailed. At the bottom, there is text in an older form of the German language.

artworks.title: Moses Closing the Red Sea
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting the parting of waters in a biblical scene. The illustration shows a large group of figures walking along a dry path through a body of water, led by a figure at the front holding a staff. The parted waters reveal chaotic waves with several figures and objects being consumed by the sea. Behind the group, the sea appears turbulent, and some animals seem to be struggling against the current. The scene is rich in detail with intricate cross-hatching defining the contours of the figures and landscape. The expression and posture of the figures suggest determination and purpose as they move forward. At the bottom, there is an inscription that appears to relate to the biblical story of the Exodus, adding a textual element to the visual narrative.

artworks.title: Moses Striking the Rock
artworks.description: The image shows several figures positioned across the frame. In the center, a man with a long beard is standing and holding a staff, gesturing towards a rock with water flowing from it. He is surrounded by other bearded men in long robes. Women and children are collecting water in jugs, and some animals are drinking from the stream. In the background, there are pitched tents. A block of text at the bottom includes references to religious scripture (Exo. 17.a. and g.Reg.19.a.b.).

artworks.title: Moses with Outstretched Arms
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical battle scene with figures in armor and a man with raised arms. The drawing portrays a dramatic moment during a battle, set in a field surrounded by combatants in ancient armor, with shields and swords. To the left, a bearded man stands on a stone pedestal with his arms raised, supported by two others. To the right, a chaotic battle unfolds as soldiers engage in combat, some on foot and others wielding weapons and shields. The background features a rolling landscape with hills and small clusters of trees. The text at the bottom explains the scene, likely based on a historical or religious narrative depicted in the detailed style characteristic of Northern European engravings from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Moses Receiving the Tablets
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene with Moses receiving tablets on a mountain. The image shows a figure on the left giving two stone tablets to a figure kneeling on a mountaintop. On the right side, there are figures around a pedestal with a sculpted animal on top. In the background, there are conical tents, a tree, and detailed monochrome shading.

artworks.title: Moses Speaks to the Children of Israel
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals gathered together with tents in the background. The line drawing features figures wearing robes or cloaks, some with head coverings. In the background are tent-like structures and a faint landscape. The detailed linework and hatching give the image depth and texture. Below the drawing is a block of text written in a Gothic script.

artworks.title: The Lord Sweetens the Waters of Marah
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures by the water. The image depicts several figures gathered around a water source. One figure appears to be holding a small branch or staff, and another figure is interacting with a large log that stretches into the water. Behind them, numerous additional figures are clustered, and in the top right corner, a celestial figure is seen among clouds. The setting includes a background of hills or trees, and there's textual content below the image in an old European language.

artworks.title: Nadab and Abihu
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures surrounded by flames. The artwork depicts the engulfment of the figures amidst smoke and flames. The composition is dynamic, focusing on the movements of the flames around the figures. The smoke adds to the chaotic scene. The linework shows detailed portrayals of the figures and their expressions, conveying a sense of desperation. The contrasts and motion create visual tension in the scene.

artworks.title: The Blossoming of Aaron's Rod
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting an ancient religious scene. The image shows a group of robed figures gathered around an altar in an open outdoor area. To the left of the figures stands a large menorah with seven branches. Behind the group, there is a grand box-like structure, with two winged cherubs above it. In the background, there are dome-like structures and mountains. The foreground features a gate-like structure and some vegetation. There is decorative script at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Balak's Sacrifice, and Balaam's Prophecy
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene with two robed figures engaged in conversation. In the background, there are multiple altars with burning offerings and animals on them. At the top of the image, there is a star surrounded by clouds. In the distance, two figures are on horseback with an angelic figure. The drawing is accompanied by German text referencing the Book of Numbers, specifically the episode involving Balak and Balaam. The scene captures a moment of religious significance emphasizing divine messages and prophetic elements.

artworks.title: The Twelve Stones, and the Waters of the Jordan are Divided
artworks.description: This is a monochrome drawing showing a group of people setting up tents and gathering large stones. The composition includes figures lifting stones, tents with individuals around them, and a group carrying a rectangular object. There are trees, hills, and a German text annotation in the drawing.

artworks.title: The Fall of Jericho
artworks.description: This is a drawing of men carrying an ark and blowing trumpets with a city collapsing in the background. The image depicts figures marching and playing horns. In the background, structures of a fortified city are crumbling. In the foreground, several muscular figures are carrying an object reminiscent of a religious ark or chest, emphasizing their motion and strength. One individual appears to be kneeling. The architecture in the distance shows fractured walls, crumbling towers, and chaotic smoke, suggesting a city under assault. The drawing employs detailed line work and shading to convey depth and movement within the composition. Text at the bottom provides a narrative context to the visual scene.

artworks.title: The Sacrifice of Gideon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elderly man gesturing towards an angel descending from a cloud. The angel holds a staff and extends it towards an altar emitting vapor or smoke. The angel's detailed wings are in motion, set against a background of clouds and landscape. Gothic script below the image provides a contextual reference.

artworks.title: Samson Slays the Philistines
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a muscular figure holding a bone above their head. The setting includes a large rocky formation, various figures in different poses, and a background of trees and sky. An inscription in stylized script is located below the image. The composition is detailed with use of shadow and texture, emphasizing movement and intensity.

artworks.title: The Death of Samson
artworks.description: This is a drawing of collapsing structures and figures. The image depicts a chaotic environment with rubble, fallen pillars, and beams. There are human-like forms amidst the debris, some appearing trapped or in distress. The structures are grand architectural elements, shattered and crumbling. The lines and shading suggest motion and collapse. At the bottom, there is text in a stylized font. The drawing conveys a dramatic and intense atmosphere.

artworks.title: Absalom Slain by Joab
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a group of armored horsemen and a figure entangled in a tree. The central figure appears caught in the branches of a tree by their head or hair. Nearby, mounted soldiers with long spears are riding energetically towards the figure. The soldiers wear helmets with crests and armor typical of classical or medieval periods. The background shows rolling hills and sparse foliage. The image features fine line work, intricate details, and careful shading, resembling an etching or engraving. Below the scene, there is a block of text in an old script referencing 2 Samuel 18:8 from the Bible.

artworks.title: Jesse Sends David to His Brothers and Saul
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a pastoral landscape. The scene depicts one elder figure wearing long robes, gesturing towards a younger figure who appears to carry a sling, with a bag hung over his shoulder. The ground beneath them is slightly hilly, with trees and hills stretching into the background. The elder figure's demeanor seems guiding or instructive, while the younger figure appears poised for action or movement. The background features sparse trees and shrubbery, suggesting a serene setting. The drawing includes text at the bottom.

artworks.title: David Beheads Goliath
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a victorious figure with a decapitated head and a sling, a fallen giant, and fantastical creatures in a landscape. The scene includes intricate details such as the figure holding a large head in one hand and a sling in the other. In the background, there are mythical creatures engaging with each other. The landscape includes a few trees and hills, suggesting a rural environment. An inscription at the bottom adds to the context of the image.
